Overview

The Feuji Innovation Challenge 2026, in collaboration with T-Hub, invites Working professionals, tech enthusiasts, and startups to create the next generation of Autonomous Quality Assurance (QA) tools. The focus is to develop an intelligent engine that can autonomously analyze, test, and enhance web applications using AI.

Focus Areas:

  • AI Agents
  • Quality Engineering
  • Testing Performance
  • Mobile Applications
  • Autonomous discovery
  • Bug detection
  • Hygiene classification
  • Defect scoring
  • Visualization

Join us to transform ideas into intelligent solutions and shape the future of AI-powered applications!

Themes

Develop a Bug & Hygience Discovery Engine

Feuji’s ReQon; an advanced AI-powered autonomous testing platform currently supports recording and replaying user flows. However, it still requires human setup and supervision. To evolve into a truly autonomous testing system, ReQon must be enhanced to: • Understand the structure and navigation flow of any website. • Independently detect functional, UI, performance, and accessibility issues. • Identify and classify hygiene issues (content, layout, navigation, SEO, accessibility). • Execute AI-driven testing cycles, including handling authentication and authorization (OAuth2, SSO, tokens). The mission: Build a unified AI engine that can crawl, analyze, detect, and classify defects – essentially a self-driven QA inspector. Objective Develop a Bug & Hygience Discovery Engine that autonomously: • Crawls any web application URL and identifies page types (e.g., dashboard, list, form, wizard, report). • Detects and classifies visual and functional issues using DOM structure, Playwright logs, and browser telemetry. • Generates a structured Defect Knowledge Graph linking pages → elements → issue types → severity. • Produces a Hygiene Score for each page based on defect density and issue mix.

Eligibility

Experienced startups in the focus areas:

  • AI Agents
  • Quality Engineering
  • Testing Performance
  • Mobile Applications
  • Autonomous discovery
  • Bug detection
  • Hygiene classification
  • Defect scoring
  • Visualization

Startups must leverage AI to enhance application interaction, learning, and automation.

Startup Stage

Eligible startups should have a viable product or prototype; ideation-stage startups are not eligible.

Ideal team composition

Each team should ideally include a Developer, AI/ML Engineer, and Tester.

FAQs

Feuji AI Innovate: Hackathon for Next-Gen AI Applications is a 48-hour AI-focused competition at T-Hub in Hyderabad. Developers, professionals, and students build cutting-edge AI solutions. Participants receive mentorship, compete for prizes, and may secure collaboration opportunities with Feuji.

Startups, professionals, and students with AI-driven application scanning solutions can apply. Teams must have 2-3 members, ideally including a Developer, AI/ML Engineer, and Tester.

Shortlisted teams will be invited to the launch event to receive problem statements, guidelines, and mentorship to develop their solutions.

Teams must submit their working prototype code and a demo video demonstrating their solution before the deadline.

The jury will evaluate teams based on impact, feasibility, and execution. Finalists will present refined prototypes before the winners are announced.
